move: apple fades up, bite taken, leaf unfurls, slow breath, fades out
how: A single 320x360 SVG on a light grey stage: a hand-drawn dark apple body path, a background-coloured circle acting as the bite, a highlight stroke and a leaf path with its transform origin at the stem. The fruit fades in from opacity 0 and scale 0.92 (expo.out) over the first 30%; at 15% the bite circle slides in from x:90 (expo.out) so it appears to be bitten; at 23% the leaf unfurls from scale 0/rotation -60 with back.out(2); at 33% the highlight draws with DrawSVG (power2.out). Hold: the whole logo breathes scale 1.03 yoyo on sine.inOut (37-73%) while the leaf sways rotation 4 yoyo. Exit at 88%: the logo fades to 0 with scale 0.95 (power2.in).
adapt: Swap the body/leaf paths for any silhouette logo, change #1d1d1f and the stage colour (the bite circle must match the stage); keep the fade-bite-leaf order and the sine breath.
port: mount(el, shot) inserts the SVG into el; animate(el, shot, D) returns the same timeline with entrances at 0-0.4 of D, breath 0.37-0.73, exit 0.88. Requires DrawSVGPlugin only for the highlight stroke; the leaf's transform-origin is set in CSS with transform-box:view-box.
caveats: requires DrawSVGPlugin for one small stroke
the apple is a hand-drawn approximation of the mark, not the official path
bite is a stage-coloured circle, breaks on non-flat backgrounds
fades to nothing at the end, close to the first frame
